description: Shared preset for repos that vendor sources via tools/sync-vendored.py. Adds a jsonata custom manager that reads upstream versions from vendored.json. Consumers must still define postUpgradeTasks (run `python3 tools/sync-vendored.py --id {{{depName}}}`, whose --id resolves a vendor by id, depName, or packageName, with their files[].target fileFilters) and allow-list the command via RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS.

matchStrings: vendors.{ "depName": depName, "packageName": packageName, "datasource": datasource, "currentValue": currentValue, "currentDigest": currentDigest, "versioning": versioning, "extractVersion": extractVersion }
